blocks.text: SINGAPORE — The Department of Health (DOH) is closely monitoring reports of a suspected plague case in Russia following the death of a laboratory worker in Siberia, Malacañang said on Wednesday. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said health authorities were taking into account recommendations from the World Health Organization (WHO) amid concerns over the incident.
